name: testnet
notes: BLANK FORM, NOT A PLAN. Copy to config/deployments/97/<name>.plan.json, fill in every null with a value verified against BSC testnet, and delete the "template" flag; "name" must equal <name>. Nothing here is invented: the VRF coordinator, the key hash, the feed proxies and the token addresses are operator inputs (SPEC section 14: the operator supplies actual chain/token/feed configuration). Both scripts/validate_config.ts and DeploymentLib.readDocument refuse a document while "template" is true. The chain facts below are the ones already recorded in config/chains/97.json.

maxRequestCostDerivation.note: Record the lane's documented maximum gas price, the coordinator's verification overhead and the premium, each verified against the deployed coordinator on the day of the deployment (SPEC section 7.1).

ownership.note: SPEC section 12.1 allows one operator Safe for owner, treasury and seed on testnet; mainnet requires three separate Safes with 2-of-3 hardware keys (SPEC section 10.5). The final owner must accept both Ownable2Step transfers, and the seed account must call Vault.authorizeSeed itself before any seed entry.

assets.name: BNB
assets.exactTransferEvidence: Native path: the Vault credits exactly msg.value and checks the exact debit on withdrawal, so no token transfer hook can change the amount (SPEC section 3.1).
